verdict.rationale: Drata is a compliance automation platform, so ISO 27001 framework support is a fair axis to judge. However, no evidence item mentions ISO 27001, the Annex A control set, a Statement of Applicability, or certification-audit artifacts. The generic Frameworks, Controls and Audits API endpoints (List Frameworks, Create Custom Framework, List Audits) are adjacent building blocks, not documented ISO 27001 support, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a security engineer, ISO 27001 is a first-class framework — the current Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability, and certification-audit artifacts are supported, not just mapped
